integrity: Reproducible exact Kraus and phase checks support but do not substitute for the analytic proof; no claim of independent audit, priority certification or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two-dimensional coins with exactly one common invariant ray and positive available stay probability there.
Only ray-preserving stay operators are parametrized; the alternative first-return probability notion is not proved.
The drift recurrence theorem is imported from Loebens and is not re-proved.
title: Complete stay-operator design and a phase-independent convergence rate for a reducible qubit open quantum walk
